$what: Every schema file production is built from, and where the rig gets it (2026-11-07). The Mac rig once had 0028 and the email confirmations applied by hand, so a rig built from the repository alone lacked them. rig/migrations-check.mjs fails when a schema file is missing here, when its rig migration is missing, or when a copy has drifted from its source. A file the rig does not take says why.

docs/supabase-agent-intake.sql.why: the people, cancel and contact writes arrive in rig 0014–0016

docs/supabase-permissions.sql.also: rig/up.sh applies the current file at every start, so the grants are today's
